meaning:
ποιητής, -οῦ ὁ
(ποιέω), [in LXX: 1Ma.2:67 * ;]
in cl.,
1. a maker, author.
2. Esp., a poet: Act.17:28. Later,
3. a doer: τ. νόμου, Rom.2:13, Jas.4:11 (1Mac, l.with); ἔργου, Jas.1:25; λόγου, ib. Jas.1:22-23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
